judgements.reason: Says grieving is useless; enemies angle is off and a little dismissive.
About friends dying and the world moving on; not a ghosting friend.
Death of distant friends; misreads a friend who simply went silent.
Replace rather than weep; framed around burial, feels blunt here.
About contentment with little; nothing to do with a lost friend.
Loss and 'what after this'; centred on death, loosely related.
Happy people need friends; abstract, doesn't meet the hurt.
Other friends should console; slightly scolding for someone grieving one friend.
Crying with no one near; mood matches, situation does not.
Close friends have forgotten me; names the feeling of being dropped.
Bear absence cheerfully; assumes willing absence, not silence.
About devotional tears and 'our vileness'; off-target for friendship grief.
Weeping at night, no comforter, friends gone; echoes the tears.
Moderate tears over a dead friend; death frame doesn't fit.
Absence wears friendship down; explains drift, cold for someone crying.
Lack of contact destroys friendships; analytical, little comfort.
Praise of solitude; beside the point of losing a best friend.
Friends taken away, eyes dim with grief; voices the lament.
About the body constantly changing; off-topic.
Silent sorrow heard by God; general, not about the friend.
Sorrow fades once you stop watching it; speaks to being tired of crying.
Health and extinguishment; unrelated.
Friends owe kindness to the fainting; shares theme only.
The past friendship still abides; offers something to keep despite loss.
Fair-weather friends vanish in a crisis; fits being let down.
Friends should come unasked in trouble; touches on asking for help.
Friends needed in adversity; general.
About bitter-tempered people; off-topic.
Enjoy affections near us; loosely about friendship.
Not fretting about missing a meeting; misses the point.
Hospitable host whose visitor never comes; faint echo.
A friend loves at all times; names what was missing.
True friends don't abandon in trouble; helps her see who to keep.
Avoid hot-tempered friends; unrelated.

Individual versus groups; tangential.
Ways of drawing people together; generic.
Consolation for a lost friend; off-target.
Using time with talent; unrelated.
Society too frequent and cheap; loosely about social gatherings.
Mourning a dead friend; wrong situation.

Friends tested in adversity pull away; fits the flat-tire moment.

Favours don't win friends; relevant though framed for the wealthy.
About justice and dispositions; off-topic.
Presence with friends matters; general.
Fending off others' demands; opposite of her need.
About keeping gossip to yourself; off-topic.
Friends dying; doesn't fit drifting apart.

Fair-weather friends; not this situation.
Accepting death calmly; off-topic.
Grey hair doesn't make an elder; unrelated.

Human mutual support; general.

Mortality; unrelated.
